summary: Prepared experimental Cursor CLI support locally for review: README, usage guide, evidence overview, decision, changelog and website source now give reuse-first installation, documented-but-untested ~/.cursor/skills placement, slash and plain-prompt use, and test limits. A public-safe derived extract of the bounded Cursor Free trial (seven print-mode sessions, one attempt each) retains the failed model attempt, the unmet adoption direct-read loading criterion, mixed CLI builds and client side effects. Skills, VERSION files and published bundle v0.2.7 are unchanged; nothing is committed or deployed and the live website is unchanged.
sources: Owner request: Go ahead and add experimental Cursor CLI support to context-docs, keeping the test limitations clear. Keep the changes local for review.
authority: Project owner request for local changes for review; no commit, push, release, deployment or new model trial.
